'''Foragers''' were animals from [[New Plympto/Legends|New Plympto]]. They had feathers, and used chin-tusks for digging up fungi and roots for [[Foodstuff/Legends|food]].<ref name="CatCW">''[[Coruscant and the Core Worlds]]''</ref>
